components.name: Solid Button

components.html: Get started
components.css: .ds-btn-solid { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .6rem; padding: .75rem 2rem; color: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); background: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); border: 1px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); border-radius: 0; font: 600 .875rem/1.2 var(--fb-font-body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-solid svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-solid:hover { color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); background: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); border-color: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); } .ds-btn-solid:hover svg { transform: translateX(.18rem); } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-solid:active { color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); background: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); border-color: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); }

components.name: Protocol Rail
components.description: Signature ordered journey for Challenge, Prove, and Verify.
components.html:
1. 1

    Challenge

    Public policy. The relying party fixes the request.

  2. 2

    Prove

    Private witness. The wallet proves the bounded relation.

  3. 3

    Verify

    Closed result. The relying party applies policy and replay handling.
components.css: .ds-rail { position: relative; padding: 1.5rem; color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); background: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); } .ds-rail ol { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-rail li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.75rem minmax(0,1fr); gap: 1.5rem; align-items: start; } .ds-rail-node { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; place-items: center; color: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); background: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); border: 1px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); font: 700 1rem var(--fb-font-display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); } .ds-rail-track { position: absolute; top: 4.1rem; bottom: 4.1rem; left: 2.85rem; width: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.28); } .ds-rail-signal { position: absolute; left: -4px; top: 0; width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); box-shadow: 0 0 1.5rem rgba(45,216,163,.8); animation: ds-proof-signal 4.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite; } .ds-rail h3 { margin: 0 0 .35rem; color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); font: 600 1.8rem/1.08 var(--fb-font-display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); } .ds-rail p { margin: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); font: 400 .95rem/1.55 var(--fb-font-body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-rail strong { color: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); } .ds-rail:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); outline-offset: 4px; } @keyframes ds-proof-signal { 0%,10% { top: 0; } 42%,54% { top: calc(50% - 4px); } 88%,100% { top: calc(100% - 9px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rail-signal { top: calc(100% - 9px); animation: none; } }

components.name: Path Card
components.description: A major square container for one implementation or assurance path.
components.html:
Build against the supported boundary.

Implementation path. Install the package, construct a typed request, and keep verification policy at the application boundary.

Getting started
components.css: .ds-path-card { padding: clamp(2rem,5vw,4rem); color: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); background: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); border-left: 1px solid var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 5rem 0 4.375rem -1.25rem rgba(0,0,0,.14); font-family: var(--fb-font-body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-path-card h3 { max-width: 15ch; margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); font: 600 clamp(2rem,1.5rem + 1.3vw,3rem)/1 var(--fb-font-display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); } .ds-path-card p { color: var(--fb-color-text-muted, #3f4b70); line-height: 1.55; } .ds-path-label { color: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c) !important; font-weight: 600; } .ds-path-card a { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; color: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); border-top: 1px solid rgba(15,35,124,.22); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15,35,124,.22); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-path-card svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-path-card a:hover { color: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); } .ds-path-card a:hover svg { transform: translateX(.18rem); } .ds-path-card a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-path-card a:active { color: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Ruled claim-to-source row for repository-backed assurance evidence.
components.css: .ds-evidence { margin: 0; color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); background: var(--fb-color-blue, #0f237c); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); font-family: var(--fb-font-body, 'Public Sans', Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-evidence > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem,.7fr) minmax(0,1.3fr); gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-evidence dt { color: var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); font: 600 1rem var(--fb-font-display, 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); } .ds-evidence dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-evidence code { padding: .12em .35em; color: var(--fb-color-white, #fff); background: rgba(5,13,48,.35); font-family: var(--fb-font-mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace); } .ds-evidence:hover > div { border-bottom-color: rgba(45,216,163,.6); } .ds-evidence:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--fb-color-mint, #2dd8a3); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-evidence:active { background: var(--fb-color-navy, #050d30); }

narrative.overview:
The SD-JWT ZK documentation inherits the Forkbomb Vite Theme exactly: structural blue and deep navy establish a technical field, mint marks meaningful signals, and white or cloud surfaces give dense protocol material room to read. The visual system is candid and architectural rather than ornamental. Every division should clarify a boundary, owner, state, or path through the documentation.

The homepage expresses that world as a three-stage Challenge → Prove → Verify journey, but the reusable system is broader: square geometry, one-pixel rules, condensed display type, plain reading type, and lateral depth. Forkbomb-expression watermarks may provide quiet identity on large dark fields; they stay subordinate to content and disappear in forced-colors mode.
keyCharacteristics: Structural blue and deep navy fields with sparse mint signals.
Square silhouettes and one-pixel rules throughout controls and containers.
Barlow Semi Condensed for hierarchy; Public Sans for sustained reading.
Lateral shadows and tonal contrast instead of floating rounded cards.
Native VitePress navigation, search, reading, and accessibility behavior.

rules.name: The Mint Means Something Rule
rules.body: Use mint to identify progress, focus, active state, or a meaningful boundary; do not spread it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Field Contrast Rule
rules.body: Large sections alternate white, cloud, structural blue, and deep navy so information architecture remains visible before the copy is read.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed speaks hierarchy; Public Sans explains. Do not introduce a third expressive typeface.

rules.name: The Short Display Rule
rules.body: Display text must remain compact enough to preserve the condensed face's authority and the site's strong field geometry.

rules.name: The Protocol Before Cards Rule
rules.body: Use ordered rails, ruled lists, and explicit field divisions when the content describes sequence or responsibility. Cards are reserved for genuinely parallel paths or bounded comparisons.

rules.name: The Lateral Depth Rule
rules.body: When depth is needed, cast it sideways from a square surface; do not substitute soft centered elevation.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Navigation, buttons, document blocks, and ordinary containers remain flat at rest.

rules.name: The Square Means Exact Rule
rules.body: Preserve zero-radius corners across new controls and containers; rounding would contradict the exact, bounded relation the interface communicates.

dos: Do use structural blue and deep navy as information-bearing fields, with mint reserved for signals and active boundaries.
Do preserve square geometry, one-pixel rules, lateral depth, and the established two-font hierarchy.
Do keep proof, application policy, and operational trust visibly separated in layout as well as copy.
Do preserve visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, forced-colors fallbacks, color-mode support, and native VitePress interaction.
Do use the authored ArrowMark SVG for directional actions.
donts: Don't turn protocol sequence, evidence, or responsibility boundaries into a grid of interchangeable feature cards.
Don't use mint as a large decorative fill when it does not communicate a signal, state, or boundary.
Don't introduce rounded pills, soft centered shadows, gradient-filled controls, or generated-glyph arrows.
Don't let the Forkbomb expression watermark compete with headings or body copy.
Don't add raster imagery without recording its source and generation or licensing provenance; the current shipping system contains no raster assets.
